  "required_fixes": [
    "R3 follow-up (high) — crates/desktop-core/src/offline.rs:609-615 and authority/offline_domain.rs:718,1270-1284: confirmation persistence can fail after rename when opening or syncing the directory fails. confirm_draft discards that error; clear_draft then reads the newly visible attempt bytes, treats them as sufficient continuity and deletes the previously confirmed local recovery copy. Readability does not establish that the replacement commit completed durably. The oversized-record test covers refusal before rename, leaving this unconfirmed-commit path unresolved. Retain the recovery copy until the replacement's durability is positively established, including after a failed commit or a retry that finds identical bytes. Acceptance: inject a failure after rename at directory-sync completion, complete a successful hosted save/resolve and request clear; the recovery draft remains until a successful durability confirmation, and the newest work survives the tested recovery boundary without lease extension or mutation replay.",
    "R5 follow-up (high) — crates/desktop-core/src/authority/learner_domain.rs:1187 and authority/offline_domain.rs:282,465-530,674-679: foreground calls allocate their observation stamp before joining offline-store opening. While Opening is blocked, a new generation can issue a stamp below a persisted future stamp. Opening subsequently seeds the counter, but it cannot repair that already-issued stamp; a fresh hosted attempt lock arriving afterwards is rejected by cache's comparison. If background revalidation is pending or unavailable, an older, otherwise lease-valid unlocked attempt remains available offline despite the foreground denial. The new clock-rollback test waits for Ready before issuing calls and misses this race. Coordinate cache-affecting request ordering with persisted-stamp initialization while preserving ordering between concurrent requests. Acceptance: seed ahead-of-clock stamps with a currently valid lease, hold opening, admit a foreground attempt read, then finish opening and return a hosted lock with background revalidation unavailable; offline reads and a subsequent restart must retain the lock. Older delayed responses must still lose to newer observations."
  ],
  "blockers": [],
  "evidence_gaps": [],
  "optional_suggestions": [
    "Classify the two surviving course-revalidation mutations explicitly. They leave the validated-stamp guard intact, which can make them equivalent under the current record invariant; the evidence records 50 named-guard failures out of 52 mutations, rather than 52 killed mutations."
  ],
  "limitations": [
    "Independently verified all four supplied fingerprints, the 321-entry source inventory, all 114 packet references, run/log/artifact hashes, installed shared-package inputs, pinned Academy 532809aa4bb2e1484e11ca9f7a414328260c7901 tree and the passing C06 attempt-05 predecessor receipt. Hash consistency establishes binding to the submitted inputs, not cryptographic proof of who performed a run.",
    "Attempt-03 R1, R2 and R4 are addressed in the inspected paths: retired views cannot enqueue device changes after ownership transfers; a download checks both observation and validation stamps; confirmed changed work invalidates earlier step verdicts and newer draft/result/conflict state moves together. R3 now retains the local copy when the cached attempt cannot hold it. R5 seeds subsequent stamps from persisted records once opening completes. The two required fixes concern the remaining failure windows.",
    "Independently ran six in-memory React/JSDOM probes against the actual pinned draft hook. Failed-save/latest-edit recovery, delayed device load after confirmation, delayed device acknowledgement across mounts, late remote failure and success after a newer view closes, and unreadable-copy preservation all pass. These used scripted mutation/device boundaries, not a native window.",
    "The two remaining findings are source-path and interleaving analyses. Did not inject filesystem failures, run filesystem-writing Rust tests, alter the system clock or repeat native interaction: this request permits writes only to the designated verdict. Inspected the actual remediation tests and their source-bound execution records.",
    "Submitted passing gates report 203 desktop tests, 58 core unit tests, 1362 shared presentation tests, 30 C07 integration tests, 120 selected frontend tests and one truth-graph test. Mutation evidence contains 52 mutations, 50 named-guard failures, two survivors and six passing baselines. These results establish their covered cases, not the two remaining windows.",
    "All 65 submitted C07/C01/C04/C05/C06 native checks report pass on executable 399c7076c5aee83ceab681520cb06231f40526a702537368fb7cc5c434307859. Inspected native observations and relevant retained evidence; native Keychain denial, spoken VoiceOver and hosted Academy qualification are not established by these synthetic flows.",
    "The Academy pin is locally committed; the packet reports its branch remains unpushed because of pre-push content-suite RPC timeouts. The standalone Academy web regression log is from 9f24d67c; the shared presentation gate covers the current pin. Fresh remote retrieval was not established. No application source was changed, no product endpoint was called and no real credential was accessed. This verdict covers C07 only; hosted qualification remains C25 and signed installed-package qualification remains C26."
  ],
